theme: Organic Luxury Enterprise (Light Theme). A fusion of premium Ayurveda (natural, earthy, trustworthy) and modern enterprise fintech (clean, structured, highly legible like Stripe or CRED). Strictly avoids the typical cheap 'MLM' aesthetic.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-semibold text-[#0B4D2E]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-[#17201B]

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Use 'Noto Sans Devanagari' when switching to Hindi language.
Do NOT use pure bold for everything; leverage font-medium and font-semibold to create elegant hierarchy.
Use #F7F9F7 as the main app background to give an organic paper-like feel.
Limit the use of #C9A227 (Gold) to premium indicators, badges, or special hover states.
Never use pure black or grey. Neutrals must pull from the provided palette (#17201B, #66736B).

surfaces: Cards: #FFFFFF background, 1px solid border (#EAF5ED or black/5), max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg).
Shadows: Very subtle, diffuse shadows. shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(11,77,46,0.04)]
Glassmorphism: Use for sticky navs/headers. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#0B4D2E]/10. Never use 100% transparent backgrounds over content.
micro_interactions: Hover states: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5), subtle shadow increase, and color darkening.
Buttons: pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth corners (rounded-lg) with smooth transitions (transition-all duration-200).
Loading: Use elegant skeleton loaders, no generic spinners.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. If a card has borders, use internal padding p-6.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Bento. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Stretch items to match neighbors (h-full).
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Desktop: Fixed Left Sidebar (collapsible). Mobile: Fixed Bottom Navigation (Home, Income, Team, Orders, More). Do not cram mobile nav into a top hamburger.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and dashboard data. Optical alignment for icons inside buttons.

rules: Use framer-motion for page transitions (fade-in, slide-up).

components.stat_card: Minimalist bento box. Hero metric top-left. Trend indicator (+/-). Minimal chart preview.
components.wallet_card: Use #0B4D2E background with #C9A227 accents for the premium wallet feel.
components.status_badge: Pill shape. Red/Green based on distributor activation status. Example: bg-[#C62828]/10 text-[#C62828].
components.tables: Clean, row borders only (no vertical lines). Align monetary values to the right. Use Shadcn Table.
components.forms: Floating labels or very clean stacked labels. Shadcn Input/Select with customized border focus (ring-[#176B43]).

hero_background.description: Textured gold and green leaf for premium background overlay.

products.description: Flat lay of herbal supplements with ginkgo leaves on marble surface.
Flat lay of herbal capsules, leaves, and bottle on marble surface.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create the app using React (.js extensions, NO TypeScript/tsx).
Implement routing for: Landing, Auth, Dashboard, Wallet, Products, Checkout, Admin Panel.
Mobile layout must use a persistent Bottom Navigation bar for the app portion.
Ensure the Hindi/English bilingual switch is accessible in the header.
Ensure all Shadcn components are fully restyled to match the 'Organic Luxury Enterprise' theme.
Avoid generic MLM templates; strictly emulate Stripe/CRED for the dashboard UX.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
